games.name: [Nightmare] Pocong: Cursed Hospital [Scary Horror]
games.desc:
PvP Mode Added!

A restless soul, the "Pocong," wanders the halls of an abandoned hospital. As an investigator, uncover the truth, collect lost belongings, and perform the ritual to lay the spirit to rest.

Will you soothe the soul, or become the hospital’s next target...?

📝 HOW TO PLAY:

🔍 INVESTIGATE: Search for items required for the ritual.
🏃 SURVIVE: Run and hide from the Pocong roaming the corridors!
🕯️ RITUAL: Return items to the desk to awaken the spirit's memories.
🚪 ESCAPE: Complete all 4 stages to break the curse.

⚠️ WARNING: This game contains intense jumpscares, flashing lights, and loud noises. Play at your own risk. Headphones recommended for the best experience.

🌸I'm a solo indie developer from Japan. Thank you so much for playing and supporting my game! If you enjoy the game, please support me by leaving a 👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite!
